bio: An unpretentious, friendly vibe is key to the charms of this modern café-brasserie found down a cobbled street in the shadow of the impressive St. Mary's Church. With a bright conservatory extension on the ground floor and a more rustic feel upstairs, it offers a pleasant environment for breakfast, a light lunch or something more substantial. The menu takes local produce and applies influences from other areas of Europe, often promoting the unfussy cooking style of the Mediterranean....
